tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. ONE single full-body transparent PNG of the exact adopted QUOKKA character from image1 with eyes gently CLOSED for a blink. This is a fresh redraw from the reference, intended to replace only the blink key pose in a production animation set. Absolute priority: reproduce the reference's ordinary relaxed standing body and all proportions, position, head/body size relationship and anatomical foot support. Do NOT shorten or slim the torso; do NOT squat, tilt the head, lift arms, move feet, or make the head larger. Match the reference's long pear-shaped cream belly from neck down to hips, short forepaws resting on the chest, large hindfeet and gently rightward tail, two ears, small hair tuft, muzzle and nose. The closed eye curves replace the two open eyes, while the little smile and every other pose element remain as in reference. The whole figure sits at the SAME scale and position on a 1254-square canvas as the reference, approximately head top y96, foot bottom y1165, body support center x570. The outside tail extends right as in the reference. Do not use a little compact sprite-sheet body: this must preserve the adopted normal character's torso length and thickness, including chest, hips and thighs. Warm brown outline, tan fur, pale yellow muzzle/chest/belly, soft clean watercolor paper texture, same fur tuft edges and line character; no glossy shading, no patchy smears, no new markings. Fully closed relaxed eyelids as simple gentle brown curves, no eyeballs showing, no added lashes. Transparent RGBA, no background, ground shadow, border, props, labels or lettering. Entire ears, tail, forepaws, hindfeet visible with original transparent margins. Exactly two arms/two legs/one tail. Clean finished character art suitable for neutral -> closed blink -> neutral at 430px reference-height display without any body jump.
